record.name: SendGrid
record.one_liner: A cloud-based email delivery platform that provides transactional and marketing email at scale.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free trial directly on the website with no credit card required.
record.api_note: The SendGrid Email API enables businesses to create, send, and manage emails at scale through RESTful APIs.

evidence.quote: Twilio SendGrid supports API keys delivered via Bearer token or Basic authentication
Free trial lets you send 100 emails/day for 60 days
The SendGrid Email API enables businesses to create, send, and manage emails at scale through RESTful APIs or SMTP relay.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes SendGrid Email Management and Reporting tools as MCP-compatible endpoints.
